A LIVING LABORATORY

The architecture
is the experience.

Hempcrete and hemp-lime plaster sit alongside stone, timber and natural finishes. The house offers a place to look closely at materials and how they come together.

01

Hemp & lime

See the building material and finishes in context. Ask about the construction process and the choices behind the walls.

02

Stone, timber & air

Explore the relationship between local materials, openings and natural ventilation.

03

Sun & rain

Rooftop solar panels and rainwater harvesting are part of the house’s approach to everyday resource use.

LEARN THROUGH PLACE

Curious about building with hemp?

Enquire about natural-building visits, workshops and the GoHemp connection. Ask the hosts for current opportunities, dates, fees and technical contacts; no scheduled programme is guaranteed.
